evidence.quote: MaVI is a defining feature of advanced HCC and confers a dismal prognosis.27,33 While multiple studies have compared bevacizumab-based versus lenvatinib-based combination regimens as first-line therapy for unresectable HCC, evidence of their relative survival benefits in the MaVI subgroup remains inconsistent.28,29,37 This real-world, multicenter, two-arm comparative study evaluated the efficacy and safety of triple therapy between lenvatinib and bevacizumab, both combined with ICIs and interventional therapy in HCC patients with MaVI.
